response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Order_Items), product_stats AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(oi.product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT n FROM total) AS share FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code), type_stats AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(ps.avg_qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(ps.item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(ps.share) AS avg_share FROM product_stats ps JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = ps.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share) AS avg_order_item_share FROM type_stats;
